name: Ads — Multimodal Enrich + Embed + Supabase
description: Multimodal classify (gemini-2.5-flash) + embed (gemini-embedding-2, 3072d). Processes unanalyzed ads and error retries only. Defensive base64 check prevents filesystem-v2 reference errors.

parameters.jsCode:
const p = $('Parse Embedding').item.json;
const e = p._enrichment || {};
const now = new Date().toISOString();
const body = {
  ad_type: e.ad_type || null, funnel_stage: e.funnel_stage || null,
  hook: e.hook || null, core_angle: e.core_angle || null,
  target_persona: e.target_persona || null, pain_point: e.pain_point || null,
  emotional_tone: e.emotional_tone || null, visual_description: e.visual_description || null,
  talent_description: e.talent_description || null, color_palette: e.color_palette || null,
  shot_style: e.shot_style || null, on_screen_text: e.on_screen_text || null,
  creative_brief: e.creative_brief || null, confidence: e.confidence || null,
  lightbulb_status_quo: e.lightbulb_status_quo || null,
  lightbulb_alternatives: e.lightbulb_alternatives || null,
  lightbulb_mechanism: e.lightbulb_mechanism || null,
  lightbulb_offer: e.lightbulb_offer || null,
  lightbulb_new_life: e.lightbulb_new_life || null,
  native_ui_hijacking: e.native_ui_hijacking ?? false,
  hook_timing_seconds: e.hook_timing_seconds || null,
  analyzed_at: p._enrichment ? now : null,
  enrichment_error: p._enrichment_error || null,
  embedding: p._embedding || null, embedding_text: p._embedText || null,
  embedded_at: p._embedding ? now : null,
  asset_path: p._hasMedia ? p._assetPath : null,
  asset_public_url: p._hasMedia ? ('https://fliqklclucdhjemdjatr.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/ad-assets/' + p._assetPath) : null,
  media_downloaded: p._hasMedia ? true : false,
  downloaded_at: p._hasMedia ? now : null, updated_at: now
};
return { json: { _adId: p.id, _patchBody: JSON.stringify(body) } };
